summary: Associate Director-level ALM and balance-sheet risk specialist with ~7 years across IRRBB analytics, multi-scenario cash flow projection, and hedging analysis for institutional portfolios. At Moody's Analytics, holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for portfolios of $5–25bn per engagement, including review under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks aligned with banking book IRRBB standards. Prior pension ALM, LDI, and interest-rate / inflation / currency hedging delivery at Ortec Finance. CFA charterholder; dual MSc; advanced Python and SQL.
core_skills: ALM & IRRBB — EVE / NII, parallel & non-parallel shocks
Structural interest rate risk & duration gap analytics
Balance sheet risk modelling & banking book analytics
Fixed income & interest rate derivatives valuation
Yield curve construction, calibration & key-rate duration
Multi-scenario cash flow projection & liquidity gap modelling
Hedging strategy analysis (interest rate, inflation, FX)
Stochastic scenario generation & Monte Carlo simulation

roles.title: Asst. Director — Modelling Services (Investment & ALM Risk Lead)

sections.heading: Structural interest rate risk & ALM analytics
bullets: Hold delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5–25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Oversee interest-rate risk and duration analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks across the banking book, aligned with IRRBB standards analogous to OSFI B-12 and Basel Committee frameworks.
Review derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, verifying consistency of sensitivities and scenario impacts at portfolio-level ALM aggregates that inform hedging decisions.

sections.heading: Cash flow projection & balance-sheet modelling
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity and balance sheet visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset-allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioral cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations.

sections.heading: Governance, tooling & stakeholder reporting
bullets: Operate within a formal model-governance framework; escalate outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility; serve as primary escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into scalable Python analytics pipelines with embedded logging, validation, and auditability controls.

Prepare analytical summaries for senior stakeholders covering interest-rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative outputs into committee-ready narratives.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; advised on asset, liability, and ALM configurations and validated model outputs post-deployment.

Served as technical liaison between client investment teams and Product Owners, scoping requirements into structured development requests; contributed to successful migration of all assigned client accounts from legacy Calypso to PFaroe PM.

roles.title: Senior Consultant — IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.
Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on adoption of IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 standards; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest-rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.
Conducted liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis, evaluating trade-offs between return objectives, duration alignment, and liquidity considerations for pension-fund clients.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Advised clients on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation trade-offs via stress testing and sensitivity analysis; presented findings to investment committees on-site.

Led onboarding and ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger (UPP / JSPP), developing and validating the model capturing Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.
